answer: Epoch-Overlap Continuity Gate. Each agent identity must reappear within a bounded lag window across consecutive epochs; dormant identities fall to a nadir of zero weight and must re-earn standing through observed interactions. Weight peaks at a summit only after sustained cross-epoch presence, like a lotus rooted through seasons. Attackers pay by maintaining many live, interacting puppets continuously—real compute, bandwidth, and response latency per fake identity, every epoch—making mass fabrication costlier than honest operation.
